name: Shinooka Misa
source:
Misa is a teacher at the local highschool and the advisor for the cooking club. A kind and gentle teacher she is prone to becoming flustered when embarrassed or caught off guard...

[Taken from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/10/01/natsu-no-ame-review/]omochikaeri's review[/url].]
